name: sentinel-connectors
description: Sentinel OS connectors — searches named public sources into the local evidence store, and reads back what was captured

scripts.test: node test_connect.js && node test_crosslink.js && node test_lobby.js && node test_graph.js

//: neo4j-driver is OPTIONAL. Every connector, crosslink, lobby and the graph PREVIEW run without it; it is required only by `sentinel connect graph --push`, which is the one command that writes to a database. It is listed under optionalDependencies so a plain `npm install` failing to fetch it does not break the desk, and so the test suite never depends on it — graph.js takes a session object, and the tests pass a fake one.
